timing: life gain is a simultaneous result of damage rather than a trigger
choices: affected player orders applicable life-gain replacements
apnap: simultaneous result subjects are prepared in APNAP order
layers: ability-adding and ability-removing effects determine source state
replacement_effects: prevented damage produces no life gain
life gain remains replaceable before atomic commit
control_change: the source controller at the damage event gains life
zone_change: source last-known information is required after an unrepresented zone change
source_leaves: represented source snapshots retain controller and keyword facts

variants: several sources create separate life-gain events
known_blockers: unrepresented source last-known-information and continuous ability grants remain fail-closed
